display.description: Specifies the type of rendering box used for an element. Controls the outer display type (block/inline) and inner display type (flow/flex/grid/table).

position.signature: position: static | relative | absolute | fixed | sticky
position.description: Sets how an element is positioned in the document flow. `relative` offsets from normal position; `absolute` removes from flow relative to positioned ancestor; `fixed` relative to viewport; `sticky` toggles between relative and fixed based on scroll.

flex.description: Shorthand for flex-grow, flex-shrink, and flex-basis. Determines how a flex item grows or shrinks to fill available space in a flex container.

grid.description: Shorthand for grid-template-rows, grid-template-columns, grid-template-areas, grid-auto-rows, grid-auto-columns, and grid-auto-flow. Establishes a grid formatting context.

margin.description: Sets the margin area on all four sides. Margins create extra space around an element. Accepts auto for horizontal centering of block elements.

padding.description: Sets the padding area on all four sides. Padding creates space between the element's content and its border. Cannot be negative.

box-sizing.description: Defines how the total width and height of an element is calculated. `content-box` (default) excludes padding/border from width/height; `border-box` includes them.

z-index.description: Sets the stacking order of a positioned element. Elements with a higher z-index are rendered in front. Only applies to positioned elements (not static). Creates a new stacking context when set to a non-auto value on positioned elements.

overflow.signature: overflow: [ visible | hidden | clip | scroll | auto ]{1,2}
overflow.description: Controls what happens when content overflows an element's box. Can set x and y independently. `hidden` clips and prevents scrolling; `scroll` always shows scrollbars; `auto` shows scrollbars only when needed; `clip` clips without creating a scroll container.

opacity.description: Sets the transparency level. Values from 0.0 (fully transparent) to 1.0 (fully opaque). Applies to the entire element and all its children. Creates a new stacking context.

transition.description: Shorthand for transition-property, transition-duration, transition-timing-function, and transition-delay. Defines smooth transitions between CSS property values when they change.

animation.description: Shorthand to configure CSS animations. References @keyframes rules by name. Controls timing, repetition, direction, and fill behavior.

transform.description: Applies 2D or 3D transformations — translate, rotate, scale, skew, matrix, perspective. Multiple functions are applied right to left. Creates a new stacking context and containing block for positioned descendants.

var().description: Substitutes the value of a CSS custom property. Custom properties are defined with a -- prefix and are inherited. An optional fallback value is used if the property is not defined or is invalid.

calc().description: Performs mathematical calculations for CSS values. Supports +, -, *, / operators and can mix different units (px, %, rem, vw, etc.). Nesting is allowed: calc(calc(...) + ...).

@media.description: Applies enclosed styles conditionally based on the result of one or more media queries. Tests media type (screen, print) and features (width, height, orientation, color-scheme, prefers-reduced-motion, hover, pointer).

@keyframes.description: Defines the intermediate steps in a CSS animation as a set of keyframes. Each keyframe describes the style at a given percentage (0%/from to 100%/to) of the animation cycle. Referenced by animation-name.

@supports.description: Feature query that applies styles only if the browser supports the given CSS declarations or features. Supports `not`, `and`, `or` operators and `selector()` function.

@layer.description: Cascade layer. Earlier layers lose to later ones regardless of specificity.

@container.description: Applies rules based on a container's size rather than the viewport.

custom-properties.description: CSS custom properties (CSS variables) are entities defined by authors that contain specific values reusable throughout a document. Set with -- prefix and accessed via var(). They participate in the cascade and are inherited by default.

specificity.description: The algorithm browsers use to determine which CSS declaration applies. Three components: ID selectors (#id), class/attribute/pseudo-class selectors (.class, [attr], :hover), and type/pseudo-element selectors (div, ::before). Higher specificity wins. !important overrides normal specificity.

gap.description: Spacing between flex, grid or multi-column items. Replaces margin hacks.

aspect-ratio.description: Preferred width-to-height ratio, sizing one axis from the other.

object-fit.signature: object-fit: fill | contain | cover | none | scale-down
object-fit.description: How replaced content (img, video) fills its box.

grid-template-areas.description: Names grid regions so children can be placed with grid-area.

grid-auto-flow.description: How auto-placed items fill the grid; dense backfills holes.

minmax().description: Grid track sizing function bounding a track between two values.

clamp().description: Clamps a value between bounds — the usual fluid-typography tool.

min().description: Smallest of the arguments; max() gives the largest.

container.description: Establishes a query container so @container can match its size rather than the viewport's.

@property.description: Registers a custom property with a type, making it animatable.

:has().description: Matches an element containing something matching the argument — the parent selector.

:is().description: Matches any selector in the list, taking the highest specificity of them.

inset.description: Shorthand for the four offsets of a positioned element.

place-items.description: Shorthand centring grid or flex items on both axes.

will-change.description: Hints at upcoming changes so the browser can promote a layer. Overuse costs memory.

content-visibility.description: Skips rendering off-screen subtrees, a large win on long pages.

scroll-snap-type.signature: scroll-snap-type: none | x | y | block | inline | both
scroll-snap-type.description: Makes a scroll container snap to its children's snap positions.

color-mix().description: Blends two colours in a given space.

light-dark().description: Picks a value from the used colour scheme, without a media query.
